name: Wood
description: A neat stack of about ten freshly cut round logs with pale cut ends and rough brown bark, piled in a small pyramid.

name: Mercury
description: A round-bellied dark iron cauldron filled to the brim with shining liquid silver mercury, standing on a few flat stones.

name: Ore
description: A heap of heavy lumps of dark blue-grey iron ore with metallic glints and rusty spots.

name: Sulfur
description: A conical heap of bright yellow powdery sulfur with a few crystalline yellow lumps on top.

name: Crystal
description: A cluster of large translucent deep-red crystals growing from a small rock, sharp hexagonal prisms pointing upward and outward.

name: Gems
description: A small heap of polished faceted gemstones of many colours: red rubies, green emeralds, blue sapphires, yellow topazes and white diamonds.

name: Gold
description: A heap of shiny gold coins and a few small gold ingots piled into a low rounded mound, warm yellow gold with bright highlights.

name: Treasure Chest
description: A wooden treasure chest bound with iron bands, its lid open and overflowing with gold coins and a few jewels.

name: Campfire
description: A campfire of crossed logs in a ring of stones with bright orange flames, a small iron pot and a little sack of coins beside it.

name: Spell Scroll
description: A large rolled parchment scroll, half unrolled, with a red wax seal and a ribbon, lying on the ground; ornate faded ink patterns, no readable letters.

name: Pandora's Box
description: An ornate cube-shaped golden box with a heavy lid, its faces decorated with embossed blue-and-gold arcane emblems, glinting rim.

name: Artifact (generic)
description: A small ornate treasure: a jewelled golden goblet, a short sword and a gilded helmet lying together on a red velvet cloth.

name: Sawmill
description: A rustic sawmill: an open timber shed with a plank roof on thick posts, a large circular saw blade at the side, stacks of sawn planks and round logs in front, a few pine saplings around it.

name: Alchemist's Lab
description: An alchemist's laboratory: a two-storey stone and red-brick house with a red clay tile roof and a round tower, a large black iron cauldron with silver mercury standing at the front door.

name: Ore Pit
description: An open-cast ore pit: a shallow quarry dug into brown earth with stepped rocky walls, heaps of dark grey ore lumps, a wooden mine cart full of ore and a pickaxe by the edge.

name: Sulfur Dune
description: Several large rounded dunes of bright yellow sulfur with darker ochre streaks, with a small wooden shovel and a bucket in front.

name: Crystal Cavern
description: A crystal cavern: a rugged brown rock outcrop with a dark cave mouth in the front; big clusters of glowing deep-red crystals grow out of the rock around the entrance, a small mine cart with red crystals in front.

name: Gem Pond
description: A gem pond: a small clear blue pond framed by brown rocks and bare grey shrubs, colourful gemstones sparkling along its shore and a wooden wheelbarrow filled with gems at the front.

name: Gold Mine
description: A gold mine dug into a steep weathered brown-and-ochre rock outcrop with some green moss: a timber-framed mine entrance in the front face, a small iron mine cart full of glittering gold nuggets on short rails in front of the entrance.

name: Abandoned Mine
description: An abandoned mine: a craggy grey-brown rock outcrop with an old timber mine entrance boarded up with broken planks, cobwebs and scattered bones and rubble in front.

name: Pine tree A
description: A tall dark-green conifer (spruce/pine) with dense layered drooping branches forming a narrow cone, straight reddish-brown trunk visible at the bottom.

name: Pine tree B
description: A shorter, bushier dark-green fir tree with a broad cone of thick needle branches and a slightly uneven crown, short brown trunk.

name: Snowy pine A
description: A tall dark-green spruce tree whose layered branches are heavily laden with clean white snow, a narrow cone shape, brown trunk at the bottom.

name: Snowy pine B
description: A smaller bushy fir tree covered with thick caps of white snow on every branch tier, dark green needles peeking out.

name: Leafy tree A
description: A broad deciduous oak tree with a dense rounded crown of rich green leaves in several clumps and a thick gnarled grey-brown trunk.

name: Leafy tree B
description: A slender deciduous tree (lime/birch-like) with an oval crown of fresh green leaves and a straight light trunk.

name: Autumn tree
description: A deciduous tree in autumn colours: a rounded crown of orange, golden-yellow and red leaves on a dark brown trunk.

name: Dead tree A
description: A dead leafless tree with a twisted grey-brown trunk and bare crooked branches spreading upward like claws.

name: Dead tree B
description: A small dead leafless tree, broken top, a few thin bare black branches, cracked pale bark.

name: Pine forest
description: Clumps of pine trees (assembled from tree_pine_a/b on the DEF's blocked cells).

name: Snowy pine forest
description: Clumps of snow-laden pines (assembled from tree_pine_snow_a/b).

name: Leafy forest
description: Mixed green deciduous forest (assembled).

name: Autumn forest
description: Autumn-coloured forest (assembled).

name: Dead forest
description: Groups of dead leafless trees (assembled).

name: Grass mountains (large)
description: A large mountain massif of grey granite with three or four jagged peaks, steep cliffs and scree, green grass and a few small pine trees on the lower slopes.

name: Grass mountains (medium)
description: A medium rocky mountain of grey granite with two craggy peaks, steep cliff faces and green grassy foothills.

name: Snow mountains (large)
description: A large mountain massif with three or four sharp peaks of dark grey rock thickly covered with snow and ice, snow fields on the ledges and steep rocky cliffs.

name: Snow mountains (medium)
description: A medium mountain with two sharp snow-capped peaks of dark grey rock, snow lying on all ledges, steep cliffs.

name: Brown mountains (large)
description: A large mountain massif of layered brown and ochre sandstone rock with several eroded peaks, deep vertical crevices and sparse dry bushes.

name: Brown mountains (medium)
description: A medium mountain of layered brown-ochre rock with two eroded peaks, cliffs with deep crevices and loose scree at the foot.

description: One big weathered grey granite boulder with a smaller stone beside it, patches of moss and lichen.

name: Rock group
match: re:avlrg0[12] re:avlrd0[12] re:avlrk3d0 re:avlrr05 re:avlr0[2-9]r0 re:avlrhl0[23] re:avlbuzr0
description: A low group of three or four large weathered grey boulders and flat rock slabs lying together, some moss.

name: Castle town
description: A knightly castle of light grey ashlar stone: a massive square curtain wall with crenellated battlements, several tall square towers with crenellations, a central keep with blue-grey slate roofs and a big arched gatehouse in the middle of the front wall; green grassy hill around the walls.

name: Rampart town
description: A woodland town of elves and dwarves: large timber-framed halls with steep wooden-shingle gable roofs and carved gable ends on mossy stone foundations, wooden stairs and a palisade gate, on a green hill with stone terraces and a few trees.

name: Tower town
description: A wizards' city of slender white marble towers with tall pointed bright-blue conical roofs and gold finials, joined by white walls and bridges, standing on white crystalline rocks dusted with snow.

name: Inferno town
description: An infernal fortress of black-grey stone: a tall keep with several jagged spiky towers, windows glowing orange-yellow, standing on a mound of dark volcanic rock and red-brown ash with cracks of glowing lava.

name: Necropolis town
description: A gothic necropolis: a tall narrow keep of dark grey stone with pointed lancet windows faintly glowing green and steep steel-grey spires, stepped terraces with crenellations, on a crag of pale sandstone with a few dead trees and old tombstones.

name: Dungeon town
description: An underground warlock stronghold: a huge round fortress of grey stone ringed by many cylindrical towers with crenellated tops, built into a crater of rust-brown and ochre rock, a dark gate at the front.

name: Stronghold town
description: A barbarian stronghold: rough massive walls of piled brown and ochre stone blocks reinforced with timber, blocky square towers with crude battlements, wooden gate, earthy brown palette.

name: Fortress town
description: A swamp fortress: a stepped pyramid-like mound of mossy green-grey stone blocks overgrown with vines and moss, with a dark stone gateway at the front and small green-roofed huts on the terraces.

name: Conflux town
description: An elemental city of rose-pink and sandstone walls with many slender round towers topped by turquoise onion domes and gold spires, and a big copper-bronze domed palace in the centre.

name: Cove town
description: A pirate coastal fortress: a big round tower of weathered sandstone with timber hoardings and a wooden crown, smaller round towers and wooden palisade walls, tropical palm trees and jungle plants around it on a rocky green island hill.

name: Factory town
description: An industrial desert city of cream sandstone and brass: a large domed hall with arched windows and a copper-brown dome, slender tall chimney columns at the corners, riveted metal details, on a sandy rocky plateau.

name: Bulwark town
description: A northern giants' fortress of grey stone: several very tall narrow towers with flat crenellated tops, huge carved stone statues of bearded giants flanking the gate, steep stone steps, snow lying on the rocks around it.

name: Hero (generic)
description: A knight in polished steel plate armour with a short dark cape riding a sturdy grey horse with a deep red cloth caparison, a lance held upright in his right hand.

name: Knight
description: A knight in shining silver plate armour and a plumed helmet riding a white horse with a black-and-white chequered caparison, a long lance held upright.

name: Necromancer
description: A gaunt necromancer in a black hooded robe with a bone staff riding a pale grey-white horse with tattered black caparison.

name: Wizard
description: A bearded wizard in a flowing purple robe and pointed hat holding a tall staff, riding a grey dappled horse with a purple saddle cloth.

name: Barbarian
description: A muscular barbarian with a horned helmet, fur cloak and a big axe riding a tan horse with a dark red caparison.

name: Ranger
description: A ranger in green and brown leather with a hooded cloak and a longbow on the back riding a brown horse with a light leather saddle.

name: Pikeman
description: A foot soldier in a steel helmet and breastplate over a blue tabard with a white cross, holding a long pike upright, sturdy boots.

name: Centaur
description: A centaur: muscular human torso with a leather bracer and a wooden spear rising from the body of a chestnut-brown horse, long dark hair.

name: Gremlin
description: A small green-skinned gremlin with big pointed ears in a red tunic, carrying an iron ball and chain on its shoulder.

name: Imp
description: A small crouching imp with leathery orange-brown skin, little horns, bat ears, a long thin tail and clawed hands, grinning.

name: Skeleton
description: A walking human skeleton of yellowed bones holding a rusty short sword, hunched forward.

name: Walking Dead
description: A shambling zombie with pale grey-green rotting skin, torn ragged grey clothes and outstretched arms.

name: Troglodyte
description: A hunched blind troglodyte with smooth brown reptilian skin, no eyes, a long spear and a small round shield.

name: Goblin
description: A small green goblin with long pointed ears in a ragged brown tunic, carrying a crude spiked club.

name: Wolf Rider
description: A green-skinned goblin warrior with a club riding a huge grey wolf with bared fangs.

name: Gnoll
description: A hyena-headed gnoll with spotted brown fur in a leather harness holding a flail, standing upright.

name: Lizardman
description: An upright lizardman with dark blue-green scales and a pale belly holding a short bow, a quiver on its back and a long tail.

name: Pixie
description: A tiny pixie girl with orange-and-black butterfly wings, red hair and a green leaf dress, hovering low, feet almost touching the ground.

name: Peasant
description: A simple peasant in a purple-brown tunic and brown trousers holding a wooden pitchfork.

name: Halfling
description: A small halfling with curly brown hair in a brown leather jerkin, holding a sling, bare hairy feet.

name: Nymph
description: A water nymph: a slender female figure made of translucent pale-blue water and white foam, long flowing hair, arms raised gracefully.

name: Kobold
description: A small stocky kobold in heavy grey-blue fur and leather clothes with a horned hood, holding a pick, snowy north look.

name: Green Dragon
description: A large green dragon with emerald scales, a lighter yellow-green belly, folded bat-like wings, horns and a spiked tail curled around its feet.

name: Behemoth
description: A huge hunched behemoth beast with shaggy brown fur, enormous clawed forearms, a horned head and bared tusks.

name: Guardhouse
description: A square guard tower of light grey stone with crenellated battlements, a wooden door, arrow slits and a small walled yard.

name: Archers' Tower
description: A tall square stone watchtower with crenellations and arrow slits, a wooden balcony under the top, grey ashlar stone.

name: Barracks
description: A fortified stone barracks: a square tower with crenellations joined to a low stone hall, banners removed, grey stone.

name: Centaur Stables
description: A long low wooden stable with a thatched roof, open stall doors, a fenced paddock and a hay pile.

name: Workshop
description: A tall wooden workshop on four stilts with a slatted roof, a big round clock face with gears on the front, ladders and wooden beams.

name: Imp Crucible
description: A pit of glowing molten fire framed by red-brown brick walls, with two tall dark pillars topped by horn-like spikes and iron grates.

name: Cursed Temple
description: A small grey stone temple in classical style with columns, a triangular pediment and broken steps, weathered and gloomy.

name: Graveyard
description: A low earthen burial mound with a few crooked tombstones, an open grave and old dark wooden coffin boards.

name: Warren
description: A stepped beehive-shaped mound overgrown with green moss and yellow lichen with round burrow openings on each tier.

name: Goblin Barracks
description: A small whitewashed stone fort with rough crenellations, a crooked wooden door and a little watch platform.

name: Wolf Pen
description: A pale stone kennel fort with crenellated walls and a wide wooden gate, scattered bones in front.

name: Gnoll Hut
description: A round hut with a conical straw thatched roof on a raised wooden platform with log walls and a short ladder.

name: Magic Lantern
description: A tall curved metal lantern post with a glowing golden lantern among lush fern-like plants and blue flowers.

name: Homestead
description: A rustic two-storey wooden house with a steep shingled roof, carved beams and a small porch, set among small bushes.

name: Dwarf Cottage
description: A grassy green mound house built into a hillock with a round wooden door, small round windows and a stone chimney.

name: Windmill
description: A tall round windmill tower of light stone and brick with a conical thatched cap and four big lattice sails with canvas.

name: Water Wheel
description: A red-roofed wooden mill house with a large wooden water wheel on its side turning in a little stream with stones.

name: Shrine of Magic Incantation
description: A small round open shrine of bronze-brown metal and stone: a domed canopy on slender columns sheltering a glowing book on a lectern.

name: Shrine of Magic Gesture
description: A small round open shrine of polished brass with a golden dome on slender columns sheltering a glowing magic orb on a pedestal.

name: Shrine of Magic Thought
description: A small round open shrine of white marble and silver with a silver dome and spire on slender columns sheltering a floating crystal.

name: Obelisk
description: A tall slender four-sided obelisk of polished deep-blue stone with carved runes and a pyramid tip, standing on a stepped stone plinth.

name: Magic Well
description: A round stone well with a small red tiled roof on two wooden posts, a bucket on a rope and glowing blue water inside.

name: Lean-to
description: A small lean-to shelter of branches and a brown canvas tarp over a log, a bedroll and a sack underneath.

name: Witch Hut
description: A crooked little witch's hut with a sagging thatched roof on a twisted stilted base, a crooked chimney and a small round window.

name: Seer's Hut
description: A round hut with a domed straw roof decorated with feathers and charms, a hanging cloth door and a small totem beside it.

name: Two-way Monolith
description: A tall arch-shaped standing stone of dark weathered rock framing a swirling glowing blue magic portal, carved horn-like ornaments on top.

name: Subterranean Gate
description: A cave entrance into the underground: a big dark arched cave mouth in a rocky hill of brown stone, a stone stairway leading down into darkness.

name: Boat
description: A small wooden sailing ship (cog) with a single mast and a furled cream sail, curved brown planked hull and a little stern castle.
